evals.prompt: Design a hybrid RAG retrieval pipeline for internal technical documentation with re-ranking and source citations.
evals.expected_output: An architecture design and implementation plan combining keyword (BM25) and dense vector search with cross-encoder re-ranking and explicit chunk citation.
assertions: Specifies a hybrid retrieval strategy combining sparse/keyword (e.g. BM25) and dense vector embeddings
Includes a re-ranking stage (e.g. Cohere or Cross-Encoder) to improve precision
Mandates source citation tracking in the generation response schema
Defines explicit chunking strategy with overlap parameters

evals.prompt: Implement an evaluation suite for the LLM using Ragas to measure Faithfulness and Answer Relevance.
evals.expected_output: An Evaluation Driven Development (EDD) script or test module using Ragas metrics to benchmark retrieval and generation quality.
assertions: Configures Ragas metrics specifically including Faithfulness and Answer Relevance
Separates system prompts from user input test data
Includes input and output guardrails or validation
Provides a fallback or degradation path for provider timeouts
